subject: GCP Marketplace listing — seller preflight & procurement cadence
messages:
From: Rajiv Patel <rajiv@cloudscale.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: procure@cloudscale.com
Date: 2026-10-25T09:12:00Z
Subject: GCP Marketplace onboarding & procurement questions

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Were ready to proceed with listing CloudScale Analytics on GCP Marketplace but have a couple of items we need to lock down for procurement:

- Confirmation on invoice flow (Redwood billing to CloudScale or via GCP marketplace pass-through).
- SLA and data residency notes to attach to the contract (weve attached our corporate SLA requirements).
- Expected timeline for SKU mapping and billing start date once the listing is approved.

Can you share a preflight checklist and a proposed handoff cadence to your procurement/ops team? Procurement prefers a single point of contact for PO routing: procure@cloudscale.com.

Attached: CloudScale_SLA_requirements.pdf

Rajiv
Head of Platform Partnerships
CloudScale Analytics
rajiv@cloudscale.com
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Patel <rajiv@cloudscale.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, alex_martinez@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-25T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace onboarding & procurement questions

Rajiv Thanks for the clear list. Ive put together an initial seller preflight checklist and a proposed procurement handoff cadence below. Ive attached the checklist workbook (gcp_preflight_checklist_v1.xlsx) for your intake team to review.

High level plan (timeline: 3-4 weeks typical):
- Week 0 (Today): Intake & preflight review. Owners: Irene (redwood) + Rajiv (CloudScale).
- Week 1: SKU & billing mapping; determine if marketplace passthrough or direct billing is required. Owners: Aditya (billing) + CloudScale procurement.
- Week 2: Legal redline window and SLA alignment. Owners: Legal ops (Redwood) + CloudScale legal.
- Week 3: Publish listing to private preview + finalize PO routing and invoice test.

Key asks for CloudScale to return this week:
1) Confirm preferred invoice flow (passthrough vs direct).
2) Provide procurement contact details for PO processing (procure@cloudscale.com is fine if thats the primary).
3) Any non-standard contract clauses in the attached SLA requirements you need us to accept.

Action items assigned:
- Aditya: lead SKU mapping and provide sample billing manifest by 2026-11-01.
- Laura: own procurement handoff and DocuSign flow with CloudScale.
- Alex: technical preflight (container image access + test account).

Proposed meeting to lock cadence: Thursday 2026-10-28 10:00am PT / 1:00pm ET. Does that work for you?

Attachments: gcp_preflight_checklist_v1.xlsx

Best,
Irene Choi
Partnerships Program Manager | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv@cloudscale.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, alex_martinez@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-25T13:09:00Z
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace onboarding & procurement questions

Quick clarifying Qs before the meeting:
- Rajiv, can you confirm whether CloudScale intends to accept Marketplace-managed billing (GCP handles customer invoices) or if youll require Redwood to invoice CloudScale directly? This affects SKU granularity and billing manifest format.
- For PO routing: who signs POs on your side? We need a named approver + email for DocuSign routing.

Ill prepare a sample billing manifest and a mapping template for our Thursday sync. If they prefer direct invoicing well map one SKU per offer and include usage tiers in the manifest.

-Aditya
Product Ops | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
From: Rajiv Patel <rajiv@cloudscale.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@cloudscale.com
Date: 2026-10-26T16:03:00Z
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace onboarding & procurement questions

Irene / team,

Thanks for the checklist and the clear owners. Thursday 10/28 at 10am PT works for us. A few quick confirmations:

- CloudScale prefers GCP marketplace passthrough billing if possible (reduces procurement friction). If passthrough creates delays well accept Redwood direct invoicing for the first 30 days to avoid hold-ups.
- PO signer: Me (Rajiv Patel) is authorized to sign standard POs; procure@cloudscale.com will submit the PO document.
- Weve attached our PO template for your legal team to review; we also attached a purchase order (CloudScale_PO_4527.pdf) for initial testing.

Action: Ive uploaded our procurement packet to the Drive link you shared and invited laura_bennett@redwood.com. Please confirm when youve received the DocuSign invite for the initial agreement so our finance team can schedule the invoice test.

Attachments: CloudScale_PO_4527.pdf

Rajiv
Head of Platform Partnerships
CloudScale Analytics
rajiv@cloudscale.com
